findings.reason: the ruling must name only the Armijo acceptance arithmetic (`required`/`sufficient` with `_SUFFICIENT_DECREASE_SLOPE`) as reusable, leaving the search direction to be supplied by the Newton caller, or a node obeying the ruling wholesale substitutes steepest descent for the Newton step §5 exists to implement.
findings.text: the §5 reuse ruling (plan comment `c-20261005T171941782407`, 2026-10-05) names `_steepest_descent_promotion` as "the Armijo backtracking search" to carry into `solve.fixed_point` "stripped of the ladder", but the function computes its own steepest-descent direction (`direction = jnp.where(..., -gradient / jnp.maximum(gradient_norm, 1.0e-300), ...)`, fixed_point.py:1691-1693) and scores it on a fixed scale ladder `_STEEPEST_DESCENT_SCALES = (1.0e-4, 1.0e-5, 1.0e-6, 1.0e-7, 1.0e-8)` (fixed_point.py:93), whereas the design (§ `solve`, line 118) requires a line search on φ=½‖F‖² along the GMRES/Newton direction with initial factor 1 and shrink factor ½; carrying this helper as the ruling directs would import a steepest-descent direction and a factor schedule whose largest step is 1e-4, so the §5 node would be built on the wrong direction

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — one owning module each hides substantial behaviour behind a single logical signature: topology.read (contour tree, null census, normal-form saddle support, axis-connected membership), current.book (exact clip integration), gs.apply (composed map plus its JVP), solve.fixed_point (Newton-GMRES at one scan call site), with forward.py reduced to the request/receipt facade.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — each retained authority is named as the owner to extend (`ConstraintPair`/`ConstraintRecord` for the row scale; polygon_moments.py for exact polygon moments; contour_tree.py/contour_tree_mesh.py for the tree; biot/null.py + biot/fieldnull.py for field-null kernels; forward.py for the moment-map derivative), and the §6 inventory folds deleted modules into these owners rather than forking them.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §2–§5 each name the mechanism they retire or merge in their own text (Topology.read; clipped_support_current_moments and the support partition; the ForwardFluxOperator map; newton_krylov/picard/operator_request_body) and §6 names the ladders, the frozen/live split and the alternate routes it deletes, so no section adds surface without accounting for what it removes.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the design cites a real owner for every mechanism it proposes (contour_tree.py, biot/null.py, polygon_moments.py, constraint.py, forward_operator.py operand layouts, clip_quadrature.py, forward.py's moment-map derivative), but the §5 reuse candidate `_steepest_descent_promotion` does not do the thing its reuse ruling says it does.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — each new module replaces rather than wraps (topology.read replaces `Topology.read`/`read_with_connectivity`; gs.apply replaces the map `ForwardFluxOperator` performs; solve.fixed_point replaces `newton_krylov`, `picard` and `operator_request_body`), and the cite-or-justify rulings require each carried helper to justify itself against the fixed-shape contract rather than be wrapped.
